title: Production pilot: guard CLI command shorthand
prompt: Execute the activated Phase 11 production pilot. Goal: make mistyped CLI command names fail fast instead of being interpreted as experiment IDs while preserving the existing numeric experiment-id shorthand. You may modify ONLY src/thought_pipeline/cli.py and tests/test_cli.py. Do not modify any other file, including workflows, dependencies, content, configuration, generated output, templates, pipeline.py, pyproject.toml, or requirements.txt. Preserve `python pipeline.py 001 --offline` as shorthand for generate. A mistyped or unknown command such as `valdate` must fail as an invalid command rather than being treated as an experiment id. Preserve all existing valid commands and behavior. Add focused regression tests in tests/test_cli.py. Do not merge the pull request. Before finishing run: python -m compileall -q src pipeline.py ; python pipeline.py validate ; python -m pytest -q ; python pipeline.py 001 --offline --output-root /tmp/ade-pilot-output --overwrite.
